title: Drip Review (2026)
intro: Drip is evaluated here as email marketing software — Drip is an ecommerce-focused email and marketing automation platform (often described as ecommerce CRM/email) with behavioral segmentation, workflows, and onsite campaigns. Single published plan scales by active people from $39/mo at up to 2,500 contacts with unlimited email sends; 14-day free trial; no forever-free plan. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Drip when ecommerce behavior-driven email automation is the job and you want a mid-tier alternative to Klaviyo/Omnisend.
verdict: Choose Drip when ecommerce behavior-driven email automation is the job and you want a mid-tier alternative to Klaviyo/Omnisend. Compare Klaviyo and Omnisend for ecommerce multichannel depth/value, ActiveCampaign for broader automation+CRM, and Brevo for send-based SMB value. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.answer: Yes. Drip is evaluated as email marketing / ESP software for campaigns, lists, and related automation — not as a full sales CRM of record.

faq.question: How is Drip priced?
faq.answer: No free plan. From $39/mo at ≤2,500 active people (unlimited sends). Scales with list size — confirm live slider. 14-day trial.
